answer: Repeated trades between the same pair decay geometrically: the k-th attestation from one partner weighs 0.5^k, so any pair caps near 2 units. A sybil ring of 1,000 accounts must therefore keep forging fresh edges, each backed by a 10 POA opal-tier bond (10,000 POA total). At every dawn close, auditors move saturated pairs to a sable list and slash their bonds. Colluders cannot share costs, since only distinct partners add weight. Honest agents trading widely barely notice.
